component.name: KeePassYB
component.summary: KeePassXC with databases on a YubiKey (unofficial fork)

description.p: KeePassYB is an unofficial fork of KeePassXC that can keep password databases on a YubiKey, through yb (https://github.com/douzebis/yb), instead of in a file. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the KeePassXC Team.

A database on the YubiKey is never written to the computer's disk; it opens with the YubiKey, and saving replaces it safely: an interrupted save keeps the previous version. Everything else is KeePassXC.
